Description: >

  MyVPC:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MySubnet

    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyInternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref MyInternetGateway

  MyENI:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkInterface

      SubnetId: !Ref MySubnet
      Description: "ENI with one primary and two secondary private IPs"
      PrivateIpAddresses:

        - Primary: false
          PrivateIpAddress: 10.0.0.11
        - Primary: false
          PrivateIpAddress: 10.0.0.12
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyENI

  MyEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

    Properties:

    Value: !Ref MyVPC

    Description: "Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref MySubnet

    Description: "Internet Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref MyInternetGateway
  NetworkInterfaceId:
    Description: "Network Interface ID"
    Value: !Ref MyENI

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create an integration between DynamoDB Streams and Amazon EventBridge using EventBridge Pipes.
  It creates a DynamoDB table with streams enabled, a custom EventBridge event bus, an IAM role with least privilege,
  an AWS Lambda function to filter and enrich events (processing only events where the "avatarUrl" field ends with ".png"),
  and an EventBridge Pipe that uses the Lambda function as an enrichment step before sending events to the event bus.

Resources:

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: UserTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: UserId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: UserId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_IMAGE

  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: CustomEventBus

  PipeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipeAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeStream
                  - dynamodb:GetRecords
                  - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt FilterAndEnrichFunction.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  FilterAndEnrichFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: FilterAndEnrichFunction
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
              // Assuming the event is a DynamoDB stream record
              try {
                  const record = event;
                  const newImage = record.dynamodb && record.dynamodb.NewImage;
                  if (!newImage || !newImage.avatarUrl || !newImage.avatarUrl.S) {
                      // Drop event if the required field is not present
                      return null;
                  }
                  const avatarUrl = newImage.avatarUrl.S;
                  if (!avatarUrl.endsWith('.png')) {
                      // Drop event if avatarUrl does not end with .png
                      return null;
                  }
                  // Enrich the event with predefined metadata
                  return {
                      detail: newImage,
                      "detail-type": "UserAvatarEvent",
                      source: "com.myapp.dynamodb"
                  };
              } catch (err) {
                  console.error("Error processing event:", err);
                  return null;
              }
          };

  DynamoDBToEventBusPipe:
    Type: AWS::Pipes::Pipe
    Properties:
      Name: DynamoDBToEventBridgePipe
      RoleArn: !GetAtt PipeExecutionRole.Arn
      Source: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn
      SourceParameters:
        DynamoDBStreamParameters:
          StartingPosition: TRIM_HORIZON
          BatchSize: 1
          MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 60
      Enrichment: !GetAtt FilterAndEnrichFunction.Arn
      Target: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
      TargetParameters:
        EventBridgeEventBusParameters: {}

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: "The name of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  EventBusName:
    Description: "The name of the custom EventBridge event bus."
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  PipeName:
    Description: "The name of the EventBridge Pipe."
    Value: DynamoDBToEventBridgePipe
  PipeRoleArn:
    Description: "The ARN of the IAM role for the pipe."
    Value: !GetAtt PipeExecutionRole.Arn
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: "The ARN of the enrichment Lambda function."
    Value: !GetAtt FilterAndEnrichFunction.Arn

Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create a centralized CloudWatch Dashboard and a set of CloudWatch Logs Insights QueryDefinition resources 
  to analyze AWS Client VPN usage patterns including connection durations, data transfer volumes (ingress/egress), and user activity 
  broken out by authentication types (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth).

Resources:

  ClientVPNLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/clientvpn/logs
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ClientVPNUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: ClientVPNUsageDashboard
      DashboardBody: >
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Endpoint-specific Usage",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /EndpointUsage/ | sort @timestamp desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Distinct User Statistics",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /UserActivity/ | sort @timestamp desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Authentication Type Breakdowns",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /AuthTypeBreakdown/ | sort @timestamp desc"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

  ADSAMLConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ADSAML/ConnectionDurations"
      QueryString: "filter @message like /ADSAML/ | stats avg(duration) as AvgDuration by endpoint"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVPNLogGroup

  ADSAMLDataTransferQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ADSAML/DataTransfer"
      QueryString: "filter @message like /ADSAML/ | stats sum(ingress) as TotalIngress, sum(egress) as TotalEgress by endpoint"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVPNLogGroup

  ADSAMLUserActivityQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "ADSAML/UserActivity"
      QueryString: "filter @message like /ADSAML/ | stats count_distinct(user) as UniqueUsers by endpoint"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVPNLogGroup

  MutualAuthConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "MutualAuth/ConnectionDurations"
      QueryString: "filter @message like /MutualAuth/ | stats avg(duration) as AvgDuration by endpoint"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVPNLogGroup

  MutualAuthDataTransferQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: "MutualAuth/DataTransfer"
      QueryString: "filter @message like /MutualAuth/ | stats sum(ingress) as TotalIngress, sum(egress) as TotalEgress by endpoint"

        - !Ref ClientVPNLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create an Amazon Timestream Database and four Timestream Tables
  with configurable retention policies and built-in error handling via DeletionPolicy and
  UpdateReplacePolicy settings.
  
  IMPORTANT:
    • Your AWS account must be enabled for Amazon Timestream LiveAnalytics in the intended deployment region.
      Contact AWS Support to have the service enabled.
    • Ensure that you deploy into a region that fully supports Timestream LiveAnalytics.
    • Verify that the IAM principal (user or role) executing this deployment has the required permissions 
      (e.g., timestream:CreateDatabase and timestream:CreateTable).
    • Set the EnableTimestream parameter to "true" only when the prerequisites are met.
    When EnableTimestream is set to "false", Timestream resources will be bypassed, but a fallback SNS Topic
    will always be created to satisfy minimum deployability requirements.

Parameters:
  EnableTimestream:
    Description: "Set to 'true' to enable creation of Timestream resources. Set to 'false' if Timestream LiveAnalytics is not enabled."
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
  TimestreamDatabaseName:
    Description: "Name of the Timestream Database"
    Type: String
    Default: "poc-database"
  BatchWriteMemoryRetentionHours:
    Description: "Memory store retention period (in hours) for poc-table-01-batch-write"
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
  BatchWriteMagneticRetentionDays:
    Description: "Magnetic store retention period (in days) for poc-table-01-batch-write"
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
  OlderRecordsMemonlyMemoryRetentionHours:
    Description: "Memory store retention period (in hours) for poc-table-02-older-records-memonly"
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
  OlderRecordsMemonlyMagneticRetentionDays:
    Description: "Magnetic store retention period (in days) for poc-table-02-older-records-memonly (minimal retention)"
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  OlderRecordsMagneticMemoryRetentionHours:
    Description: "Memory store retention period (in hours) for poc-table-03-older-records-magnetic (minimal value)"
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  OlderRecordsMagneticMagneticRetentionDays:
    Description: "Magnetic store retention period (in days) for poc-table-03-older-records-magnetic (longer retention)"
    Type: Number
    Default: 730
  CommonAttributesMemoryRetentionHours:
    Description: "Memory store retention period (in hours) for poc-table-04-common-attributes"
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
  CommonAttributesMagneticRetentionDays:
    Description: "Magnetic store retention period (in days) for poc-table-04-common-attributes"
    Type: Number
    Default: 14

Conditions:
  CreateTimestream: !Equals [!Ref EnableTimestream, "true"]

Resources:
  TimestreamDatabase:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Type: AWS::Timestream::Database
    Properties:
      DatabaseName: !Ref TimestreamDatabaseName
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  PocTable01BatchWrite:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Type: AWS::Timestream::Table
    DependsOn: TimestreamDatabase
    Properties:
      DatabaseName: !Ref TimestreamDatabaseName
      TableName: "poc-table-01-batch-write"
      RetentionProperties:
        MemoryStoreRetentionPeriodInHours: !Ref BatchWriteMemoryRetentionHours
        MagneticStoreRetentionPeriodInDays: !Ref BatchWriteMagneticRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  PocTable02OlderRecordsMemonly:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Type: AWS::Timestream::Table
    DependsOn: TimestreamDatabase
    Properties:
      DatabaseName: !Ref TimestreamDatabaseName
      TableName: "poc-table-02-older-records-memonly"
      RetentionProperties:
        MemoryStoreRetentionPeriodInHours: !Ref OlderRecordsMemonlyMemoryRetentionHours
        MagneticStoreRetentionPeriodInDays: !Ref OlderRecordsMemonlyMagneticRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  PocTable03OlderRecordsMagnetic:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Type: AWS::Timestream::Table
    DependsOn: TimestreamDatabase
    Properties:
      DatabaseName: !Ref TimestreamDatabaseName
      TableName: "poc-table-03-older-records-magnetic"
      RetentionProperties:
        MemoryStoreRetentionPeriodInHours: !Ref OlderRecordsMagneticMemoryRetentionHours
        MagneticStoreRetentionPeriodInDays: !Ref OlderRecordsMagneticMagneticRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  PocTable04CommonAttributes:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Type: AWS::Timestream::Table
    DependsOn: TimestreamDatabase
    Properties:
      DatabaseName: !Ref TimestreamDatabaseName
      TableName: "poc-table-04-common-attributes"
      RetentionProperties:
        MemoryStoreRetentionPeriodInHours: !Ref CommonAttributesMemoryRetentionHours
        MagneticStoreRetentionPeriodInDays: !Ref CommonAttributesMagneticRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  FallbackSnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: "Fallback SNS Topic"

Outputs:
  TimestreamDatabaseArn:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Description: "ARN of the Timestream Database"
    Value: !GetAtt TimestreamDatabase.Arn
  PocTable01BatchWriteArn:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Description: "ARN of the poc-table-01-batch-write"
    Value: !GetAtt PocTable01BatchWrite.Arn
  PocTable02OlderRecordsMemonlyArn:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Description: "ARN of the poc-table-02-older-records-memonly"
    Value: !GetAtt PocTable02OlderRecordsMemonly.Arn
  PocTable03OlderRecordsMagneticArn:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Description: "ARN of the poc-table-03-older-records-magnetic"
    Value: !GetAtt PocTable03OlderRecordsMagnetic.Arn
  PocTable04CommonAttributesArn:
    Condition: CreateTimestream
    Description: "ARN of the poc-table-04-common-attributes"
    Value: !GetAtt PocTable04CommonAttributes.Arn
  FallbackSnsTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the fallback SNS Topic"
    Value: !Ref FallbackSnsTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template that creates a VPC with two public subnets in different AZs,
  an Internet Gateway with proper routing, an Auto Scaling Group with EC2 instances that have Internet access,
  an ElastiCache Redis replication group configured for automated snapshot management and failover,
  and a Lambda function with an IAM Role to dynamically enable/disable snapshotting.
Parameters:
  SnapshotRetentionPeriod:
    Description: "Number of days to retain ElastiCache snapshots (0 disables snapshot retention)."
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
  InstanceType:
    Description: "EC2 instance type for the Auto Scaling Group instances."
    Type: String
    Default: t2.micro
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyInternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Enable SSH and outbound Internet access for EC2 instances"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: InstanceSecurityGroup

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for ElastiCache replication group (allows internal Redis traffic)"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElastiCacheSecurityGroup

  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LaunchTemplate"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: ami-0c94855ba95c71c99  # Placeholder AMI; update as needed.
        InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
            DeviceIndex: 0
            Groups:
              - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup

  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "1"
      MaxSize: "3"
      DesiredCapacity: "1"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AutoScalingInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: "Subnet group for ElastiCache replication group"
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-elasticache-subnet-group"

  ElastiCacheReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: "Redis replication group with automated snapshot management and failover"
      Engine: redis
      CacheNodeType: cache.t3.micro
      NumNodeGroups: 1
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      SnapshotRetentionLimit: !Ref SnapshotRetentionPeriod
      SnapshotWindow: "05:00-06:00"
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref ElastiCacheSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ElastiCacheSecurityGroup

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaElasticachePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticache:ModifyReplicationGroup
                  - elasticache:DescribeReplicationGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  SnapshotControlFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: SnapshotControlFunction
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SNAPSHOT_RETENTION: !Ref SnapshotRetentionPeriod
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          
          def handler(event, context):
              retention = os.environ.get('SNAPSHOT_RETENTION', '7')
              client = boto3.client('elasticache')
              # In a real scenario, parse event input to decide enable/disable actions.
              # For demonstration, we simply log the configured snapshot retention.
              print(f"Configured snapshot retention period: {retention} days")
              
              # Example action: Describe replication groups
              response = client.describe_replication_groups()
              print("Current Replication Groups:", json.dumps(response, indent=2, default=str))
              
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': f"Snapshot retention is set to {retention} days"})
              }
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC Id"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "Public Subnet Ids"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
  AutoScalingGroupName:
    Description: "Auto Scaling Group Name"
    Value: !Ref AutoScalingGroup
  ReplicaGroupId:
    Description: "ElastiCache Replication Group Id"
    Value: !Ref ElastiCacheReplicationGroup
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: "Snapshot Control Lambda Function Name"
    Value: !Ref SnapshotControlFunction

Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create an IoT data pipeline that routes messages from AWS IoT Core
  to an SQS queue via SNS. It creates an SQS queue to store messages, an SNS topic as a pub/sub

  from the "device/data" MQTT topic and publish them to SNS, and an IAM role for the IoT rule.

Resources:
  # SQS Queue to store IoT messages with a generated name.
  IoTDataQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "iot-data-queue-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # SNS Topic to act as the intermediary.

    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: IoT Data Topic

  # SQS Queue Policy to allow SNS to send messages to the SQS Queue.
  IoTDataQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref IoTDataQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSNSToSendMessage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt IoTDataQueue.Arn
            Condition:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/config/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref Secret

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function

      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ssm_client = boto3.client("ssm")
              secrets_client = boto3.client("secretsmanager")
              
              # Retrieve parameters using path-based lookup in SSM Parameter Store
              stack_name = os.environ.get('STACK_NAME')
              parameter_path = f"/{stack_name}/config/"
              ssm_response = ssm_client.get_parameters_by_path(
                  Path=parameter_path,
                  Recursive=True,
                  WithDecryption=True
              )
              
              # Retrieve secret value from Secrets Manager
              secret_arn = os.environ.get('SECRET_ARN')
              secret_response = secrets_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
              
              return {
                  "ssm_parameters": ssm_response.get("Parameters", []),
                  "secret": secret_response.get("SecretString")
              }

          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref Secret
      Timeout: 10

  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: "Name of the deployed Lambda Function"
    Value: !Ref LambdaFunction

        Fn::Base64:

            #!/bin/bash
            yum update -y
            yum install -y amazon-cloudwatch-agent nfs-utils aws-cfn-bootstrap

            MOUNT_POINT="/mnt/efs"

            RETRIES=0

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to deploy the Etherpad application with an automated deployment pipeline.
  It provisions a VPC with two subnets, an Internet Gateway with routing, an internet‐facing ALB,
  an Auto Scaling group using a LaunchTemplate that installs Node.js and the CodeDeploy Agent, a MySQL RDS instance,
  an S3 bucket for deployment artifacts, CodeDeploy resources for application deployment,
  IAM roles for the EC2 instances and CodeDeploy, and SSM Parameter Store for secure configuration storage.

Mappings:
  AWSRegionToAMI:
    us-east-1:
      AMI: ami-0c2b8ca1dad447f8a
    us-east-2:
      AMI: ami-00a208c7cdba991ea
    us-west-2:
      AMI: ami-0dd9f0e7df0f0a138
    eu-west-1:
      AMI: ami-047bb4163c506cd98

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EtherpadVPC

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EtherpadSubnetA

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EtherpadSubnetB

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EtherpadIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EtherpadPublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ALBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the internet-facing ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ALBSG

  EC2SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 instances running Etherpad
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EC2InstanceSG

  RDSSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the MySQL RDS instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: RDSSG

  DeploymentArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "etherpad-deployment-artifacts-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2InstancePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${DeploymentArtifactsBucket.Arn}"
                  - !Sub "${DeploymentArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:*
                Resource: "*"

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DependsOn: [EC2InstanceRole, VPC, EC2SecurityGroup]
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      Path: /

  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - tag:TagResources
                Resource: "*"

  EtherpadDBSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: "RDS master user password for Etherpad database"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        ExcludePunctuation: true
        PasswordLength: 16

  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        InstanceType: t3.medium
        ImageId: !FindInMap [AWSRegionToAMI, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64:
            Fn::Sub: |
              #!/bin/bash -xe
              yum update -y
              yum install -y nodejs aws-cli ruby wget
              wget https://aws-codedeploy-${AWS::Region}.s3.amazonaws.com/latest/install -O /tmp/codedeploy_install
              chmod +x /tmp/codedeploy_install
              /tmp/codedeploy_install auto
              systemctl start codedeploy-agent
              /opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal --exit-code $? --stack ${AWS::StackName} --resource AutoScalingGroup --region ${AWS::Region}
      LaunchTemplateName: EtherpadLaunchTemplate

  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '1'
      MaxSize: '3'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref ALBTargetGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EtherpadInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true
    CreationPolicy:
      ResourceSignal:
        Count: 1
        Timeout: PT15M

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    DependsOn: [PublicRoute, PublicRouteTable]
    Properties:
      Name: EtherpadALB
      Scheme: internet-facing
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      Subnets:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB

  ALBTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    DependsOn: ApplicationLoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: EtherpadTargetGroup
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPort: '80'
      HealthCheckPath: /

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ALBTargetGroup

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnets for Etherpad RDS instance
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      DBSubnetGroupName: etherpad-dbsubnetgroup

  EtherpadRDSInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      Engine: MySQL
      EngineVersion: "5.7.37"
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserSecret:
        SecretArn: !Ref EtherpadDBSecret
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref RDSSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: false
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  CodeDeployApplication:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: EtherpadCodeDeployApplication
      ComputePlatform: Server

  CodeDeployDeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
      DeploymentGroupName: EtherpadDeploymentGroup
      AutoScalingGroups:
        - !Ref AutoScalingGroup
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
      DeploymentStyle:
        DeploymentType: IN_PLACE
        DeploymentOption: WITHOUT_TRAFFIC_CONTROL

  EtherpadConfigurationParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /etherpad/config
      Type: String
      Value: '{"db_host": "dummy-db-host", "db_port": "3306", "other_config": "value"}'
      Description: Configuration parameter for the Etherpad application

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  ALBEndpoint:
    Description: "URL of the ALB"
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
  DeploymentArtifactsBucketName:
    Description: "Bucket for deployment artifacts"
    Value: !Ref DeploymentArtifactsBucket
  RDSInstanceEndpoint:
    Description: "RDS instance endpoint"
    Value: !GetAtt EtherpadRDSInstance.Endpoint.Address
  CodeDeployApplicationName:
    Description: "CodeDeploy application name"
    Value: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
  AutoScalingGroupName:
    Description: "Auto Scaling Group name"
    Value: !Ref AutoScalingGroup

  MyVPC:

Description: >

          Value: PrimaryVPC

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnetA

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnetB

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "MySQL RDS instance with custom parameter group, secure network isolation, and Secrets Manager integration."

Resources:
  MyVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyVPC

  DBSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSubnet1

  DBSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSubnet2

  MyRDSSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for MySQL RDS instance"
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyRDSSecurityGroup

  MyRDSSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: "Subnet group for MySQL RDS instance"
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref DBSubnet1
        - !Ref DBSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyRDSSubnetGroup

  MyRDSParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: "Custom MySQL parameter group"
      Family: "mysql8.0"
      Parameters:
        character_set_client: utf8mb4
        character_set_connection: utf8mb4
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyRDSParameterGroup

  MyDBSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: "MySQLAdminSecret"
      Description: "Secret for MySQL admin credentials"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 16

  MyRDSInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: "mysql-db-instance"
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: "8.0.45"
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref MyRDSSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref MyRDSSecurityGroup
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref MyRDSParameterGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MasterUserSecret:
        SecretArn: !Ref MyDBSecret
      MultiAZ: false

  VPCId:

    Value: !Ref MyVPC
  DBInstanceEndpoint:
    Description: "RDS Instance Endpoint"
    Value: !GetAtt MyRDSInstance.Endpoint.Address
  DBSecretArn:
    Description: "ARN of the RDS admin credentials secret"
    Value: !Ref MyDBSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create an S3 bucket that triggers a Lambda function on object creation events.
  The template includes the S3 bucket, a Lambda function with inline code (Python 3.12) to process S3 events,
  an IAM role for the Lambda, a Lambda permission allowing the S3 bucket to invoke the version-qualified Lambda function,
  and a custom resource (with a Lambda-backed function) to configure the bucket notification after creation.

Resources:
  MyLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  MyLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt MyLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps("Hello from Lambda!")
              }

  MyLambdaFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MyLambdaFunction

  LambdaPermissionForS3:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MyLambdaFunctionVersion
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: s3.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Join
        - ""
        - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
          - !Ref S3TriggerBucket
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  S3TriggerBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties: {}

  S3NotificationConfiguratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3NotificationConfiguratorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutBucketNotification
                Resource: !Join
                  - ""
                  - - "arn:aws:s3:::"
                    - !Ref S3TriggerBucket
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  S3NotificationConfiguratorLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt S3NotificationConfiguratorRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import urllib.request
          import traceback

          def send_response(event, context, responseStatus, responseData, physicalResourceId=None, noEcho=False):
              responseUrl = event['ResponseURL']
              responseBody = {
                  'Status': responseStatus,
                  'Reason': 'See CloudWatch Log Stream: ' + context.log_stream_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physicalResourceId or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'NoEcho': noEcho,
                  'Data': responseData
              }
              json_responseBody = json.dumps(responseBody)
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(json_responseBody))
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(responseUrl, data=json_responseBody.encode('utf-8'), headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as f:
                      print("Status code:", f.getcode())
              except Exception as e:
                  print("send_response failed:", e)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              s3 = boto3.client('s3')
              try:
                  bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['BucketName']
                  # Use the version-qualified ARN from the published Lambda version
                  lambda_versioned_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['LambdaFunctionVersionArn']
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      notification_config = {
                          "LambdaFunctionConfigurations": [
                              {
                                  "Id": "S3TriggerNotification",
                                  "LambdaFunctionArn": lambda_versioned_arn,
                                  "Events": ["s3:ObjectCreated:*"]
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                      s3.put_bucket_notification_configuration(
                          Bucket=bucket,
                          NotificationConfiguration=notification_config
                      )
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      s3.put_bucket_notification_configuration(
                          Bucket=bucket,
                          NotificationConfiguration={}
                      )
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", {"Message": "Notification configuration updated"})
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Exception:", str(e))
                  traceback.print_exc()
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", {"Message": "Failed to update notification configuration"})

  S3NotificationConfiguration:
    Type: Custom::S3Notification
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt S3NotificationConfiguratorLambda.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref S3TriggerBucket
      LambdaFunctionVersionArn: !Ref MyLambdaFunctionVersion
    DependsOn:
      - LambdaPermissionForS3

Outputs:
  S3BucketName:
    Description: "The name of the S3 bucket"
    Value: !Ref S3TriggerBucket
  LambdaFunctionName:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - PolicyName: FirehoseS3AndLogsPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'

                  - s3:PutObjectAcl

                  - s3:ListBucket

        BufferingHints:

        CloudWatchLoggingOptions:

          LogGroupName: !Ref FirehoseErrorLogGroup
          LogStreamName: !Ref FirehoseErrorLogStream
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Resilient Jenkins CI/CD server with automated hardware failure recovery and secure access.
  This template creates a VPC, public subnet, Internet Gateway, routing, security group,
  an EC2 instance running Jenkins with an associated static Elastic IP, an IAM role for SSM access,
  and a CloudWatch alarm to automatically recover the instance if a system failure is detected.

Mappings:
  RegionMap:
    us-east-1:
      AMI: "ami-0c94855ba95c71c99"  # Amazon Linux 2 in us-east-1
    us-west-2:
      AMI: "ami-0bdb828fd58c52235"  # Amazon Linux 2 in us-west-2

Resources:

  JenkinsVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsVPC

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref JenkinsVPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref JenkinsVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref JenkinsVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  JenkinsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Allow HTTP and ICMP traffic"
      VpcId: !Ref JenkinsVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 0
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsSecurityGroup

  JenkinsSSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Path: "/"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsSSMRole

  JenkinsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DependsOn: JenkinsSSMRole
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref JenkinsSSMRole
      Path: "/"

  JenkinsInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref JenkinsSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref JenkinsInstanceProfile
      ImageId: !FindInMap [RegionMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: !Sub |
          #!/bin/bash
          yum update -y
          yum install -y java-1.8.0-openjdk
          # Add Jenkins repository and import key
          wget -O /etc/yum.repos.d/jenkins.repo http://pkg.jenkins-ci.org/redhat/jenkins.repo
          rpm --import https://pkg.jenkins.io/redhat/jenkins.io.key
          yum install -y jenkins
          systemctl enable jenkins
          systemctl start jenkins
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsInstance

  JenkinsElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  JenkinsEIPAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation
    DependsOn:
      - JenkinsInstance
      - JenkinsElasticIP
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt JenkinsElasticIP.AllocationId
      InstanceId: !Ref JenkinsInstance

  InstanceRecoveryAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: JenkinsInstance
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm to recover Jenkins instance if a system failure is detected."
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed_System
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref JenkinsInstance
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Sub "arn:aws:automate:${AWS::Region}:ec2:recover"

Outputs:
  InstanceId:
    Description: "The Jenkins EC2 Instance Id"

Description: >

Mappings:

    us-west-2:

Resources:

      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: CF-Screenshot-SubnetA

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: CF-Screenshot-SubnetB

  SubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ScreenshotBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-screenshot-bucket-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ScreenshotBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScreenshotBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowWorkerPutObject
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt WorkerRole.Arn
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${ScreenshotBucket.Arn}/*"

  ScreenshotQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: CF-Screenshot-Queue

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

                Resource: !GetAtt ScreenshotQueue.Arn

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents

  LoadTesterInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DependsOn: LoadTesterRole
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: LoadTesterInstanceProfile
      Roles:

  WorkerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Enable SSH and HTTP outbound for worker instances

          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  LoadTesterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Enable SSH for load tester instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  WorkerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: CF-WorkerLaunchTemplate
      LaunchTemplateData:
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        ImageId: !FindInMap [RegionMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Name: !Ref WorkerInstanceProfile
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WorkerSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64:
            Fn::Join:
              - ""
              - - "#!/bin/bash\n"
                - "yum update -y\n"
                - "yum install -y chromium aws-cli liberation-fonts\n"
                - "exec > /var/log/worker-setup.log 2>&1\n"
                - "echo \"Worker instance started.\"\n"
                - "export QUEUE_URL='"
                - !Ref ScreenshotQueue
                - "'\n"
                - "export BUCKET_NAME='"
                - !Ref ScreenshotBucket
                - "'\n"
                - "while true; do\n"
                - "  MESSAGE=$(aws sqs receive-message --queue-url ${QUEUE_URL} --max-number-of-messages 1 --wait-time-seconds 10 --region "
                - !Ref "AWS::Region"
                - ")\n"
                - "  if echo ${MESSAGE} | grep -q 'Messages'; then\n"
                - "    RECEIPT_HANDLE=$(echo ${MESSAGE} | grep -oP '\"ReceiptHandle\": \"\\K[^\"]+')\n"
                - "    URL=$(echo ${MESSAGE} | grep -oP '\"Body\": \"\\K[^\"]+')\n"
                - "    if [ -n \"${URL}\" ]; then\n"
                - "      OUTPUT_FILE=\"/tmp/screenshot.png\"\n"
                - "      chromium --headless --disable-gpu --screenshot=${OUTPUT_FILE} --window-size=1280,1024 \"${URL}\"\n"
                - "      aws s3 cp ${OUTPUT_FILE} s3://${BUCKET_NAME}/$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-screenshot.png --region "
                - !Ref "AWS::Region"
                - "\n"
                - "      aws sqs delete-message --queue-url ${QUEUE_URL} --receipt-handle ${RECEIPT_HANDLE} --region "
                - !Ref "AWS::Region"
                - "\n"
                - "    fi\n"
                - "  fi\n"
                - "  sleep 5\n"
                - "done\n"

  WorkerAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WorkerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WorkerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '1'
      MaxSize: '2'
      DesiredCapacity: '1'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WorkerInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WorkerAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: SimpleScaling
      AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
      ScalingAdjustment: 1
      Cooldown: 60

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WorkerAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: SimpleScaling
      AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
      ScalingAdjustment: -1
      Cooldown: 60

  HighQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "Scale up if SQS queue has more than 5 visible messages"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt ScreenshotQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Average

    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "Scale down if SQS queue has less than 2 visible messages"
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt ScreenshotQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

  LoadTestInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      ImageId: !FindInMap [RegionMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref LoadTesterInstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref LoadTesterSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetA
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64:
          Fn::Join:
            - ""
            - - "#!/bin/bash\n"
              - "yum update -y\n"
              - "yum install -y aws-cli\n"
              - "exec > /var/log/loadtester-setup.log 2>&1\n"
              - "echo \"Load tester instance started.\"\n"
              - "QUEUE_URL='"
              - !Ref ScreenshotQueue
              - "'\n"
              - "REGION='"
              - !Ref "AWS::Region"
              - "'\n"
              - "while true; do\n"
              - "  SAMPLE_URL=\"http://example.com\"\n"
              - "  aws sqs send-message --queue-url ${QUEUE_URL} --message-body ${SAMPLE_URL} --region ${REGION}\n"
              - "  echo \"Sent message with URL ${SAMPLE_URL} to queue.\"\n"
              - "  sleep 10\n"
              - "done\n"

Description: >

  Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC). This template creates:

    - A control panel (AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel)
    - Two routing controls (one per region) (AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl)
    - A safety rule that enforces at least one routing control is active (AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::SafetyRule)
    - Two health checks (one per region) (AWS::Route53::HealthCheck)

Resources:
  ARCCluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel

      Name: ARCControlPanel

  RoutingControlRegion1:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      ClusterArn: !Ref ARCCluster
      ControlPanelArn: !Ref ControlPanel
      Name: RoutingControl-Region1

  RoutingControlRegion2:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      ClusterArn: !Ref ARCCluster
      ControlPanelArn: !Ref ControlPanel
      Name: RoutingControl-Region2

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create a scalable and monitored Amazon EFS file system with automated backups and performance safeguards.
  This template creates a dedicated VPC, subnets, EFS file system, mount targets, CloudWatch alarms for monitoring, and conditionally an AWS Backup plan and selection.

Parameters:
  BackupEnabled:
    Description: "Set to 'true' to enable automated backups with AWS Backup."
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
  BackupCronSchedule:
    Description: "A CRON expression for scheduling backups (in AWS Backup cron format, e.g., cron(0 0 * * ? *) for daily at midnight)."
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 0 * * ? *)"

Conditions:
  CreateBackupResources: !Equals [!Ref BackupEnabled, "true"]

Resources:

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EFS-VPC

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EFS-Subnet-1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EFS-Subnet-2

  EFSSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security Group for Amazon EFS - allow NFS access within VPC.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 2049
          ToPort: 2049
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EFS-SG

  EFSFileSystem:
    Type: AWS::EFS::FileSystem
    Properties:
      Encrypted: true
      PerformanceMode: generalPurpose
      ThroughputMode: bursting
      FileSystemTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedEFS

  MountTarget1:
    Type: AWS::EFS::MountTarget
    DependsOn:
      - EFSFileSystem
      - Subnet1
    Properties:
      FileSystemId: !Ref EFSFileSystem
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref EFSSecurityGroup

  MountTarget2:
    Type: AWS::EFS::MountTarget
    DependsOn:
      - EFSFileSystem
      - Subnet2
    Properties:
      FileSystemId: !Ref EFSFileSystem
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref EFSSecurityGroup

  IOUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for high IO utilization on EFS file system."
      Namespace: AWS/EFS
      MetricName: PercentIOLimit
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FileSystemId
          Value: !Ref EFSFileSystem
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  BurstCreditsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for low burst credit balance on EFS file system."
      Namespace: AWS/EFS
      MetricName: BurstCreditBalance
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FileSystemId
          Value: !Ref EFSFileSystem
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for throughput thresholds on EFS file system."
      Namespace: AWS/EFS
      MetricName: DataThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FileSystemId
          Value: !Ref EFSFileSystem
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateBackupResources
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AWSBackupAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                Resource: "*"

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: CreateBackupResources
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: EFSBackupPlan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: default
            ScheduleExpression: !Ref BackupCronSchedule
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 180
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 30

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: CreateBackupResources
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: EFSPolicySelection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt EFSFileSystem.Arn

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EFSFileSystemId:
    Description: "EFS File System ID"
    Value: !Ref EFSFileSystem
  EFSMountTargets:
    Description: "EFS Mount Targets"
    Value: !Join [", ", [!Ref MountTarget1, !Ref MountTarget2]]
  BackupPlanId:
    Condition: CreateBackupResources
    Description: "Backup Plan ID"
    Value: !Ref BackupPlan
  BackupSelectionId:
    Condition: CreateBackupResources
    Description: "Backup Selection ID"
    Value: !Ref BackupSelection

        - Key: Name
          Value: "VSCodeVPC"

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "VSCodePublicSubnet"

    Properties:

    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Allow inbound code-server access from CloudFront regional IP ranges"

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          CidrIp: "54.240.0.0/18"

        Fn::Base64: !Sub |

          set -e
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y curl
          curl -fsSL https://code-server.dev/install.sh | sh -s -- --version ${CodeServerVersion}
          mkdir -p /var/lib/code-server

        - Key: Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to deploy a Windows Server 2019 EC2 instance for CPU stress testing.
  The template creates a new VPC, subnets, an Internet Gateway, IAM roles for SSM integration and FIS,
  and a custom SSM document that runs a PowerShell script to stress the CPU.

Parameters:
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Description: "EC2 instance type for the Windows Server 2019 instance."
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.nano
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
  AmiParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Description: "SSM parameter for the Windows Server 2019 AMI. Defaults to the latest Windows Server 2019 base image."
    Default: "/aws/service/ami-windows-latest/Windows_Server-2019-English-Full-Base"
  ExistingSubnetId:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Optional: Provide an existing Subnet ID to deploy the EC2 instance into.
      Leave empty to use the subnet created in the stack.
    Default: ""
  StressTestDuration:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Duration in seconds for the CPU stress test."
    Default: 300

Conditions:
  UseCustomSubnet:
    !Not:
      - !Equals:
          - !Ref ExistingSubnetId
          - ""

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  VPCSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-Subnet"

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-RouteTable"

  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref VPCSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SSMInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-SSMInstanceRole"

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref SSMInstanceRole
      InstanceProfileName: "CFN-CPUStress-InstanceProfile"

  EC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      ImageId: !Ref AmiParameter
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !If [UseCustomSubnet, !Ref ExistingSubnetId, !Ref VPCSubnet]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-Instance"

  CPUStressSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Runs a CPU stress test on a Windows instance by spawning threads equal to the number of logical processors for a configurable duration."
        parameters:
          StressTestDuration:
            type: "String"
            description: "Duration for the stress test in seconds."
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: cpuStressTest
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'"
                - "$duration = [int]$env:StressTestDuration"
                - "$cpuCount = (Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_Processor).NumberOfLogicalProcessors"
                - "Write-Output \"Detected $cpuCount logical processors. Starting CPU stress test for $duration seconds.\""
                - "for ($i = 0; $i -lt $cpuCount; $i++) {"
                - "  Start-Job -ScriptBlock {"
                - "    param($stressDuration)"
                - "    $endTime = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($stressDuration)"
                - "    while ((Get-Date) -lt $endTime) { [Math]::Sqrt(12345) | Out-Null }"
                - "  } -ArgumentList $duration | Out-Null"
                - "}"
                - "Get-Job | Wait-Job"
                - "Write-Output 'CPU stress test completed.'"

  FISRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "CFN-CPUStress-FISRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CFN-CPUStress-FISPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "CFN-CPUStress-FISRole"

Outputs:
  InstanceId:
    Description: "ID of the deployed EC2 instance."
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance
  SSMDocumentName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM Document created for CPU stress testing."
    Value: !Ref CPUStressSSMDocument
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the created VPC."
    Value: !Ref VPC
  FISRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the FIS IAM Role."
    Value: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn
  StressTestDurationOutput:
    Description: "CPU Stress Test Duration in seconds."
    Value: !Ref StressTestDuration

Description: >

  This template creates a DynamoDB table that is configured differently for PROD and CODE environments.
Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment stage (PROD or CODE)
    Default: CODE
    AllowedValues:
      - PROD
      - CODE

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Stage, "PROD"]
  IsNotProd: !Not [!Condition IsProd]

  SupporterProductDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "SupporterProductData-${Stage}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "ID"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "ID"
          KeyType: "HASH"
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: "expiryDate"
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If 
        - IsProd
        - {ReadCapacityUnits: 20, WriteCapacityUnits: 5}
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BillingMode: !If 
        - IsNotProd
        - PAY_PER_REQUEST
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Backup
          Value: Enabled

  DynamoDBWriteCapacityScalableTarget:
    Condition: IsProd
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 500
      MinCapacity: 5
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/SupporterProductData-${Stage}"
      ScalableDimension: "dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits"
      ServiceNamespace: "dynamodb"

  DynamoDBWriteCapacityScalingPolicy:
    Condition: IsProd
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "DynamoDBWriteCapacityScalingPolicy-${Stage}"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref DynamoDBWriteCapacityScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:

        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  standards subscriptions via a custom resource using a Lambda function.

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
