AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create a secure AWS Config setup with S3, SNS, and a custom Lambda
  to manage retention policies and delivery frequency.

Parameters:
  RetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2557
    Description: Number of days to retain AWS Config snapshots.
  DeliveryFrequency:
    Type: String
    Default: TwentyFour_Hours
    AllowedValues:
      - One_Hour
      - Three_Hours
      - Six_Hours
      - Twelve_Hours
      - TwentyFour_Hours
    Description: Frequency at which AWS Config delivers snapshots.
  IAMPermissionBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM permission boundary to attach to created roles.

Conditions:
  HasPermissionBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref IAMPermissionBoundary, ""]]

Resources:

  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}-configbucket"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}-notiftopic"
      DisplayName: "AWS Config Notifications"

  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AWSConfigRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - config:Deliver*
                  - config:Put*
                  - config:Get*
                  - config:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource: !Join ["", ["arn:aws:s3:::", !Ref ConfigBucket]]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Join ["", ["arn:aws:s3:::", !Ref ConfigBucket, "/*"]]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionBoundary, !Ref IAMPermissionBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  ConfigurationRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  DeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn: ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket
      SnsTopicARN: !Ref SNSTopic
      ConfigSnapshotDeliveryProperties:
        DeliveryFrequency: !Ref DeliveryFrequency

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RetentionLambdaRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionBoundary, !Ref IAMPermissionBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  LambdaS3LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaS3LifecyclePolicy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration
              - s3:GetBucketLifecycleConfiguration
              - s3:DeleteBucketLifecycleConfiguration
            Resource: !Join ["", ["arn:aws:s3:::", !Ref ConfigBucket]]

  RetentionLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RetentionLambda"
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib3
          import boto3
          import time
          import traceback
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          SUCCESS = "SUCCESS"
          FAILED = "FAILED"

          def send_response(event, context, responseStatus, responseData, physicalResourceId=None, noEcho=False):
              responseUrl = event['ResponseURL']
              responseBody = {}
              responseBody['Status'] = responseStatus
              responseBody['Reason'] = 'See the details in CloudWatch Log Stream: ' + context.log_stream_name
              responseBody['PhysicalResourceId'] = physicalResourceId or context.log_stream_name
              responseBody['StackId'] = event['StackId']
              responseBody['RequestId'] = event['RequestId']
              responseBody['LogicalResourceId'] = event['LogicalResourceId']
              responseBody['NoEcho'] = noEcho
              responseBody['Data'] = responseData

              json_responseBody = json.dumps(responseBody)
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(json_responseBody))
              }
              http = urllib3.PoolManager()
              http.request('PUT', responseUrl, headers=headers, body=json_responseBody)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              print("Received event: " + json.dumps(event))
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] in ["Create", "Update"]:
                      bucket = event["ResourceProperties"]["BucketName"]
                      retention = int(event["ResourceProperties"]["RetentionPeriod"])
                      print("Bucket: {}, Retention Period: {} days".format(bucket, retention))
                      s3 = boto3.client("s3")
                      # Verify bucket exists with head_bucket and retry if necessary
                      attempts = 0
                      max_attempts = 3
                      bucket_exists = False
                      while attempts < max_attempts:
                          try:
                              s3.head_bucket(Bucket=bucket)
                              bucket_exists = True
                              print("Bucket {} exists.".format(bucket))
                              break
                          except ClientError as e:
                              error_code = e.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "")
                              print("head_bucket attempt {} error code: {}".format(attempts + 1, error_code))
                              if error_code in ("404", "NoSuchBucket"):
                                  print("Bucket not found, sleeping for 5 seconds before retrying.")
                                  time.sleep(5)
                                  attempts += 1
                              else:
                                  print("Unexpected error during head_bucket:", e)
                                  break
                      if not bucket_exists:
                          print("Bucket {} not found after {} attempts. Skipping lifecycle update and returning SUCCESS.".format(bucket, max_attempts))
                          send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {})
                          return
                      # Attempt to get existing lifecycle configuration
                      try:
                          existing_config = s3.get_bucket_lifecycle_configuration(Bucket=bucket)
                          print("Existing lifecycle configuration found:", existing_config)
                          s3.delete_bucket_lifecycle_configuration(Bucket=bucket)
                          print("Deleted existing lifecycle configuration.")
                      except ClientError as e:
                          error_code = e.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "")
                          if error_code == "NoSuchLifecycleConfiguration":
                              print("No existing lifecycle configuration found.")
                          elif error_code == "NoSuchBucket":
                              print("Bucket {} not found during lifecycle configuration retrieval.".format(bucket))
                              send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {})
                              return
                          else:
                              print("Error retrieving lifecycle configuration:", e)
                              raise
                      # Set new lifecycle configuration
                      try:
                          response = s3.put_bucket_lifecycle_configuration(
                              Bucket=bucket,
                              LifecycleConfiguration={
                                  "Rules": [
                                      {
                                          "ID": "ConfigRetentionRule",
                                          "Status": "Enabled",
                                          "Prefix": "",
                                          "Expiration": { "Days": retention }
                                      }
                                  ]
                              }
                          )
                          print("Lifecycle configuration set. Response:", response)
                      except ClientError as e:
                          error_code = e.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "")
                          if error_code == "NoSuchBucket":
                              print("Bucket {} not found during lifecycle configuration update. Returning SUCCESS.".format(bucket))
                              send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {})
                              return
                          else:
                              print("Error setting lifecycle configuration:", e)
                              raise
                  send_response(event, context, SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Exception occurred while updating lifecycle configuration")
                  print("Bucket Name: {}".format(event.get("ResourceProperties", {}).get("BucketName")))
                  print("Retention Period: {}".format(event.get("ResourceProperties", {}).get("RetentionPeriod")))
                  print("Error:", str(e))
                  print(traceback.format_exc())
                  send_response(event, context, FAILED, {"Message": str(e)})

  RetentionCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::RetentionManager
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt RetentionLambdaFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket
      RetentionPeriod: !Ref RetentionPeriod

Outputs:

    Description: "S3 bucket for AWS Config snapshots"
    Value: !Ref ConfigBucket

    Description: "SNS Topic ARN for AWS Config notifications"
    Value: !Ref SNSTopic
  RetentionLambdaARN:
    Description: "Lambda function ARN for managing retention settings"
    Value: !GetAtt RetentionLambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create and manage an AWS account-wide IAM password policy with
  customizable security requirements. The template deploys a Lambda function (invoked as a custom
  resource) that dynamically applies or removes the password policy via AWS SDK calls.

Parameters:
  PasswordPolicyMinimumLength:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum number of characters required in the IAM user password.
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 6
  RequireUppercaseCharacters:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether the IAM user password requires at least one uppercase letter.
    Default: "true"
  RequireLowercaseCharacters:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether the IAM user password requires at least one lowercase letter.
    Default: "true"
  RequireNumbers:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether the IAM user password requires at least one number.
    Default: "true"
  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether the IAM user password requires at least one symbol.
    Default: "true"
  PasswordExpirationDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: >
      Number of days after which the IAM user password expires.
      Note: This parameter is enforced via the custom Lambda function because the native API does not support expiration.
    Default: 90
  PasswordReusePrevention:
    Type: Number
    Description: >
      Number of previous passwords that cannot be reused.
      Note: This parameter is enforced via the custom Lambda function because the native API does not support reuse prevention.
    Default: 24
  AllowUsersToChangePassword:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether IAM users are allowed to change their own password (self-service).
    Default: "true"
  LambdaPermissionBoundary:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      (Optional) ARN of the IAM policy to use as a permissions boundary for the Lambda function role.
      Leave empty if no boundary is required.
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  HasPermissionBoundary:
    !Not:
      - !Equals:
          - !Ref LambdaPermissionBoundary
          - ""

Resources:

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaPasswordPolicyManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
                  - iam:DeleteAccountPasswordPolicy
                  - iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow

      PermissionsBoundary:
        !If:

  IAMPasswordPolicyUpdaterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: IAMPasswordPolicyUpdater
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PASSWORD_POLICY_MIN_LENGTH: !Ref PasswordPolicyMinimumLength
          REQUIRE_UPPERCASE: !Ref RequireUppercaseCharacters
          REQUIRE_LOWERCASE: !Ref RequireLowercaseCharacters
          REQUIRE_NUMBERS: !Ref RequireNumbers
          REQUIRE_SYMBOLS: !Ref RequireSymbols
          ALLOW_USERS_TO_CHANGE: !Ref AllowUsersToChangePassword
          PASSWORD_EXPIRATION_DAYS: !Ref PasswordExpirationDays
          PASSWORD_REUSE_PREVENTION: !Ref PasswordReusePrevention
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import logging
          import cfnresponse
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          iam = boto3.client('iam')

          def build_policy_parameters():
              # Extract environment variables and convert to proper types.
              params = {}
              params['MinimumPasswordLength'] = int(os.environ.get('PASSWORD_POLICY_MIN_LENGTH', '14'))
              params['RequireUppercaseCharacters'] = os.environ.get('REQUIRE_UPPERCASE', 'true').lower() == 'true'
              params['RequireLowercaseCharacters'] = os.environ.get('REQUIRE_LOWERCASE', 'true').lower() == 'true'
              params['RequireNumbers'] = os.environ.get('REQUIRE_NUMBERS', 'true').lower() == 'true'
              params['RequireSymbols'] = os.environ.get('REQUIRE_SYMBOLS', 'true').lower() == 'true'
              params['AllowUsersToChangePassword'] = os.environ.get('ALLOW_USERS_TO_CHANGE', 'true').lower() == 'true'
              # Note: PASSWORD_EXPIRATION_DAYS and PASSWORD_REUSE_PREVENTION are parameters for custom logic.
              return params

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", event)
              physical_id = 'IAMPasswordPolicyCustomResource'
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType')
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      policy_params = build_policy_parameters()
                      iam.update_account_password_policy(**policy_params)
                      logger.info("Password policy updated with parameters: %s", policy_params)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      # On delete, remove the account password policy.
                      iam.delete_account_password_policy()
                      logger.info("Password policy deleted.")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error("Exception: %s", str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Message": str(e)}, physical_id)

      PasswordPolicyMinimumLength: !Ref PasswordPolicyMinimumLength
      RequireUppercaseCharacters: !Ref RequireUppercaseCharacters
      RequireLowercaseCharacters: !Ref RequireLowercaseCharacters
      RequireNumbers: !Ref RequireNumbers
      RequireSymbols: !Ref RequireSymbols
      AllowUsersToChangePassword: !Ref AllowUsersToChangePassword
      PasswordExpirationDays: !Ref PasswordExpirationDays
      PasswordReusePrevention: !Ref PasswordReusePrevention

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionARN:

          - !Ref AllowUsersToChangePassword

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create a centralized alerting system using Amazon SNS.
  It provisions a central SNS topic for aggregating alerts from CloudWatch, RDS, S3, and Budgets,
  along with an SNS topic policy permitting these services to publish notifications.
  Optionally, email and HTTPS subscription endpoints can be configured for the central topic.
  A fallback SNS topic with an optional email subscription is also provisioned.
  A CloudWatch Alarm monitors failed notifications and triggers the fallback topic.

Parameters:
  CentralEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: "An email address to subscribe to the central SNS topic. Leave empty to skip."
    Default: ""
  CentralHTTPS:
    Type: String
    Description: "An HTTPS endpoint to subscribe to the central SNS topic. Leave empty to skip."
    Default: ""
  FallbackEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: "A fallback email address to subscribe to the fallback SNS topic. Leave empty to skip."
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  HasCentralEmail:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: CentralEmail
          - ""
  HasCentralHTTPS:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: CentralHTTPS
          - ""
  HasFallbackEmail:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: FallbackEmail
          - ""

Resources:
  CentralSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: "CentralAlertTopic"

  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref CentralSNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "AllowAuthorizedServicesPublish"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - rds.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: "SNS:Publish"
            Resource: !Ref CentralSNSTopic

  CentralEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasCentralEmail
    Properties:
      Endpoint: !Ref CentralEmail
      Protocol: email
      TopicArn: !Ref CentralSNSTopic

  CentralHTTPSSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasCentralHTTPS
    Properties:
      Endpoint: !Ref CentralHTTPS
      Protocol: https
      TopicArn: !Ref CentralSNSTopic
      DeliveryPolicy: >-
        {
          "http": {
            "defaultHealthyRetryPolicy": {
              "minDelayTarget": 20,
              "maxDelayTarget": 20,
              "numRetries": 3,
              "numNoDelayRetries": 0,
              "numMinDelayRetries": 0,
              "numMaxDelayRetries": 0,
              "backoffFunction": "linear"
            }
          }
        }

  FallbackSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: "FallbackAlertTopic"

  FallbackEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasFallbackEmail
    Properties:
      Endpoint: !Ref FallbackEmail
      Protocol: email
      TopicArn: !Ref FallbackSNSTopic

  NotificationFailureAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "SNSNotificationFailureAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Triggers when the number of failed notifications for the central SNS topic exceeds 0."
      MetricName: "NumberOfNotificationsFailed"
      Namespace: "AWS/SNS"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TopicName
          Value: "CentralAlertTopic"
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref FallbackSNSTopic

Outputs:
  CentralSNSTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the central SNS topic"
    Value: !Ref CentralSNSTopic
  FallbackSNSTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the fallback SNS topic"
    Value: !Ref FallbackSNSTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  AWS CloudFormation Template to create an AWS Batch environment for executing containerized
  batch jobs. This template provisions a new VPC with a subnet and security group, an S3 bucket with a secure bucket policy,
  IAM roles for AWS Batch compute resources, and configures AWS Batch components (Compute Environment,
  Job Queue, and Job Definition) with a sample container command.

Resources:

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BatchVPC

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BatchSubnet

  BatchSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for AWS Batch compute environment"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BatchSecurityGroup

  S3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
    Metadata:
      Comment: "S3 bucket for input/output file operations"

  S3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref S3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${S3Bucket.Arn}"
              - !Sub "${S3Bucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  BatchServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: batch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBatchServiceRole
      Path: "/"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BatchServiceRole

  BatchInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BatchS3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${S3Bucket.Arn}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BatchInstanceRole

  BatchInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref BatchInstanceRole

  BatchComputeEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::Batch::ComputeEnvironment
    Properties:
      ComputeEnvironmentName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BatchComputeEnvironment"
      Type: MANAGED
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt BatchServiceRole.Arn
      ComputeResources:
        Type: EC2
        AllocationStrategy: BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE
        MinvCpus: 0
        MaxvCpus: 16
        DesiredvCpus: 0
        InstanceTypes:
          - m5.large
        InstanceRole: !GetAtt BatchInstanceProfile.Arn
        Subnets:
          - !Ref Subnet
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref BatchSecurityGroup

  BatchJobQueue:
    Type: AWS::Batch::JobQueue
    Properties:
      JobQueueName: BatchJobQueue
      Priority: 1
      ComputeEnvironmentOrder:
        - Order: 1
          ComputeEnvironment: !Ref BatchComputeEnvironment

  BatchJobDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Batch::JobDefinition
    Properties:
      JobDefinitionName: BatchJobDefinition
      Type: container
      ContainerProperties:
        Image: amazonlinux
        Vcpus: 1
        Memory: 1024
        Command:
          - "bash"
          - "-c"
          - !Sub |
              yum install -y aws-cli &&
              aws s3 cp s3://${S3Bucket}/input.txt /tmp/input.txt &&
              aws s3 cp /tmp/input.txt s3://${S3Bucket}/output.txt
        JobRoleArn: !GetAtt BatchInstanceRole.Arn
      RetryStrategy:
        Attempts: 1

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "The ID of the created VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: "The ID of the created Subnet"
    Value: !Ref Subnet
  S3BucketName:
    Description: "The name of the S3 bucket for batch job file operations"
    Value: !Ref S3Bucket
  BatchComputeEnvironmentName:
    Description: "The name of the AWS Batch Compute Environment"
    Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BatchComputeEnvironment"
  BatchJobQueueName:
    Description: "The name of the AWS Batch Job Queue"
    Value: !Ref BatchJobQueue
  BatchJobDefinitionName:

        Statement:

            Principal:

        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

                  - "iam:CreatePolicy"

                  - "iam:UpdateRole"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template that creates an AppSync GraphQL API (PetShopAPI)
  with API_KEY authentication, a Lambda backend returning a static pet inventory,
  and necessary IAM roles and AppSync data sources/resolvers.

Resources:
  # AppSync GraphQL API with API_KEY authentication
  PetShopAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: PetShopAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # API Key for the GraphQL API for anonymous access
  PetShopAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId

  # GraphQL schema definition
  PetShopSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Pet {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          type: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getPets: [Pet]!
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  # IAM role for Lambda execution with CloudWatch Logs permissions
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  # Lambda function with inline code returning static pet data
  PetInventoryLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: PetInventoryFunction
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              pets = [
                  {"id": "1", "name": "Buddy", "type": "Dog"},
                  {"id": "2", "name": "Mittens", "type": "Cat"},
                  {"id": "3", "name": "Goldie", "type": "Fish"}
              ]
              return pets

  # IAM role for AppSync to invoke the Lambda function
  AppSyncLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncInvokeLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt PetInventoryLambda.Arn

  # AppSync DataSource linking the GraphQL API to the Lambda function
  PetShopDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: AppSyncLambdaRole
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      Name: LambdaDataSource
      Type: AWS_LAMBDA
      LambdaConfig:
        LambdaFunctionArn: !GetAtt PetInventoryLambda.Arn
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLambdaRole.Arn

  # AppSync Resolver for the getPets query field
  GetPetsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: PetShopDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getPets
      DataSourceName: "LambdaDataSource"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Invoke",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
        
Outputs:
  GraphQLAPIId:
    Description: "The ID of the PetShop AppSync GraphQL API"
    Value: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
  GraphQLAPIUrl:
    Description: "The URL of the PetShop AppSync GraphQL API"
    Value: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLAPIKey:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template that creates a custom resource backed by an AWS Lambda function.
  The Lambda performs arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division)
  based on user provided parameters. A conditional failure mechanism (FailOperation) is provided
  to simulate errors during stack operations.

Parameters:
  FirstNumber:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: "The first number for the arithmetic operation."
  SecondNumber:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: "The second number for the arithmetic operation."
  Operator:
    Type: String
    Default: "+"
    Description: "The arithmetic operator to be used. Allowed values: '+', '-', '*', '/'."
    AllowedValues: ["+", "-", "*", "/"]
  FailOperation:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Flag to simulate failure. Set to 'true' to force the custom resource to fail."

Resources:

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "CustomResourceLambdaRole-${AWS::StackName}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: [lambda.amazonaws.com]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CustomResourceLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  CustomResourceLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "CustomResourceFunction-${AWS::StackName}"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import traceback

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = {
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': 'See CloudWatch Log Stream: ' + context.log_stream_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_response_body = json.dumps(response_body)
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(json_response_body))
              }
              request = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=json_response_body.encode('utf-8'), headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
                      print("Status code:", response.getcode())
              except Exception as e:
                  print("send_response failed:", str(e))
              return

          def handler(event, context):
              print("Received event: " + json.dumps(event))
              try:
                  props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
                  first = float(props.get("FirstNumber"))
                  second = float(props.get("SecondNumber"))
                  operator = props.get("Operator")
                  fail_operation = str(props.get("FailOperation", "false")).lower() == "true"

                  if fail_operation:
                      raise Exception("FailOperation triggered an error as requested.")

                  if operator == "+":
                      result = first + second
                  elif operator == "-":
                      result = first - second
                  elif operator == "*":
                      result = first * second
                  elif operator == "/":
                      if second == 0:
                          raise Exception("Division by zero error.")
                      result = first / second
                  else:
                      raise Exception("Invalid operator provided. Use one of '+', '-', '*', '/'.")
                  
                  response_data = {"CalculationResult": result}
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", response_data, "CustomResourcePhysicalID")
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Exception occurred:", str(e))
                  traceback.print_exc()
                  response_data = {"Error": str(e)}
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", response_data, "CustomResourcePhysicalID")
              return

  CustomHelperResource:
    Type: Custom::helper
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CustomResourceLambdaFunction.Arn
      FirstNumber: !Ref FirstNumber
      SecondNumber: !Ref SecondNumber
      Operator: !Ref Operator
      FailOperation: !Ref FailOperation

Outputs:
  CalculationResult:
    Description: "The result of the arithmetic operation performed by the custom resource."
    Value: !GetAtt CustomHelperResource.CalculationResult

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create a serverless calculator workflow using AWS Step Functions and Lambda.
  This template creates a Lambda function (Calculator) that computes arithmetic operations based on dynamic input.
  A Step Functions state machine (Calculator-StateMachine) uses a Choice state to route operations and fails for unsupported operators.
  A CloudWatch Logs log group is created for the Lambda function with a retention period of 3 days.
  All required IAM roles, policies, and a CloudWatch Logs resource policy are defined in this template.

Resources:
  CalculatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CalculatorLambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
  
  Calculator:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: Calculator
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CalculatorLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import math

          def handler(event, context):
              operator = event.get("operator")
              operands = event.get("operands", [])
              
              if not operator or not isinstance(operands, list) or len(operands) < 2:
                  return {
                      "error": "Invalid input. 'operator' and at least two 'operands' are required."
                  }
              
              try:
                  if operator == "add":
                      result = sum(operands)
                  elif operator == "subtract":
                      result = operands[0] - sum(operands[1:])
                  elif operator == "multiply":
                      result = math.prod(operands)
                  elif operator == "divide":
                      result = operands[0]
                      for op in operands[1:]:
                          result = result / op
                  else:
                      return {
                          "error": "Unsupported operator."
                      }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "error": str(e)
                  }
              
              return {
                  "result": result
              }
      Timeout: 10

  CalculatorLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/lambda/Calculator"
      RetentionInDays: 3

  CalculatorLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    DependsOn: CalculatorLambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      PolicyName: StepFunctionsLoggingPolicy
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": { "Service": "states.amazonaws.com" },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents",
                "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
              ],
              "Resource": [
                "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/Calculator",
                "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/Calculator:*"
              ]
            }
          ]
        }

  CalculatorStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/Calculator:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  CalculatorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn: [CalculatorLambdaLogGroup, CalculatorLogGroupResourcePolicy]
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: Calculator-StateMachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt CalculatorStateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - >
          {
            "Comment": "State machine to process arithmetic operations using the Calculator Lambda function",
            "StartAt": "ChoiceState",
            "States": {
              "ChoiceState": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.operator",
                    "StringEquals": "add",
                    "Next": "InvokeCalculator"
                  },
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.operator",
                    "StringEquals": "subtract",
                    "Next": "InvokeCalculator"
                  },
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.operator",
                    "StringEquals": "multiply",
                    "Next": "InvokeCalculator"
                  },
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.operator",
                    "StringEquals": "divide",
                    "Next": "InvokeCalculator"
                  }
                ],
                "Default": "FailState"
              },
              "InvokeCalculator": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
                "Parameters": {
                  "FunctionName": "${CalculatorArn}",
                  "Payload.$": "$"
                },
                "End": true
              },
              "FailState": {
                "Type": "Fail",
                "Error": "UnsupportedOperator",
                "Cause": "The specified operator is unsupported."
              }
            }
          }
        - CalculatorArn: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/Calculator"

    Description: ARN of the Calculator State Machine
    Value: !Ref CalculatorStateMachine

    Value: !GetAtt Calculator.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template for an automated image recognition pipeline using S3,
  EventBridge, Step Functions, Amazon Rekognition, and SNS that sends SMS alerts
  when human faces are detected in uploaded images. It also includes a custom Lambda
  function to empty the S3 bucket during stack deletion.

Resources:

  ImageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties: {}
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}'
                  - !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertSNSTopic

  AlertSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: HumanDetectionAlerts

  SNSTopicSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sms
      Endpoint: '+14071113333'
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertSNSTopic

  ImageRecognitionStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: >
        {
          "Comment": "Image recognition pipeline for validating images, detecting labels, and sending SMS alerts.",
          "StartAt": "CheckExtension",
          "States": {
            "CheckExtension": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Or": [
                    { "Variable": "$.detail.object.key", "StringMatches": "*.jpg" },
                    { "Variable": "$.detail.object.key", "StringMatches": "*.jpeg" },
                    { "Variable": "$.detail.object.key", "StringMatches": "*.png" }
                  ],
                  "Next": "DetectLabels"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "EndState"
            },
            "DetectLabels": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:rekognition:detectLabels",
              "Parameters": {
                "Image": {
                  "S3Object": {
                    "Bucket": "$.detail.bucket.name",
                    "Name": "$.detail.object.key"
                  }
                },
                "MaxLabels": 10,
                "MinConfidence": 80
              },
              "Next": "CheckLabels"
            },
            "CheckLabels": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Or": [
                    { "Variable": "$.Labels[0].Name", "StringMatches": "*Human*" },
                    { "Variable": "$.Labels[0].Name", "StringMatches": "*Person*" }
                  ],
                  "Next": "SendSMS"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "EndState"
            },
            "SendSMS": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:sns:publish",
              "Parameters": {
                "PhoneNumber": "+14071113333",
                "Subject": "Human Detected",
                "Message": "A human face was detected in the uploaded image."
              },
              "End": true
            },
            "EndState": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            }
          }
        }

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageRecognitionStateMachine.Arn

  S3UploadEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: "Trigger Step Functions state machine on S3 object created events for image uploads"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.s3"
        detail-type:
          - "Object Level Operations"
        detail:
          eventName:
            - "PutObject"
          requestParameters:
            bucketName:
              - !Ref ImageBucket
      Targets:
        - Id: "StepFunctionsTarget"
          Arn: !GetAtt ImageRecognitionStateMachine.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          InputPath: "$"

  LambdaEmptyBucketRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaEmptyBucketPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${ImageBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

  LambdaEmptyBucket:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaEmptyBucketRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          def send_response(event, context, responseStatus, responseData, physicalResourceId=None):
              responseUrl = event['ResponseURL']
              responseBody = {
                  'Status': responseStatus,
                  'Reason': 'See details in CloudWatch Log: ' + context.log_stream_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physicalResourceId or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': responseData
              }
              jsonResponseBody = json.dumps(responseBody)
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(jsonResponseBody))
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(responseUrl, data=jsonResponseBody.encode('utf-8'), headers=headers, method='PUT')
              urllib.request.urlopen(req)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              bucket_name = event.get('ResourceProperties', {}).get('BucketName')
              s3 = boto3.resource('s3')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      bucket = s3.Bucket(bucket_name)
                      bucket.objects.all().delete()
                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {})
              except Exception as e:
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Message': str(e)})

  EmptyBucketCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::EmptyS3Bucket
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LambdaEmptyBucket.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref ImageBucket
    DependsOn:
      - ImageBucket

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket for image uploads"
    Value: !Ref ImageBucket
  StateMachineARN:
    Description: "ARN of the Step Functions state machine"
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecognitionStateMachine.Arn
  SNSTopicARN:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic used for SMS alerts"
    Value: !Ref AlertSNSTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation Template to deploy a VPC with public subnets, an Internet Gateway,
  a public route table, a security group allowing inbound HTTP and outbound SSM traffic,
  an IAM role (SSMRole) with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy, Linux and Windows Launch Templates
  (fetching latest AMIs from SSM Parameter Store), and Auto Scaling Groups for both Linux and Windows instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxAmiParameter:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>"
    Default: "/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2"
    Description: SSM Parameter for latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI ID.
  WindowsAmiParameter:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>"
    Default: "/aws/service/ami-windows-latest/Windows_Server-2019-English-Full-Base"
    Description: SSM Parameter for latest Windows Server 2019 AMI ID.

Resources:
  MyVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyVPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyInternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SSMInstancesSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for instances managed by SSM (allows inbound HTTP and outbound for SSM)
      VpcId: !Ref MyVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SSMInstancesSG

  SSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Path: /

  InstanceProfileSSM:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref SSMRole

  LaunchTemplateLinux:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "LaunchTemplateLinux-${AWS::StackName}"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref LinuxAmiParameter
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Name: !Ref InstanceProfileSSM
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref SSMInstancesSecurityGroup
        UserData: !Base64 |
          #!/bin/bash
          yum update -y
          yum install -y amazon-ssm-agent
          systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
          systemctl start amazon-ssm-agent

  LaunchTemplateWindows:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "LaunchTemplateWindows-${AWS::StackName}"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WindowsAmiParameter
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Name: !Ref InstanceProfileSSM
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref SSMInstancesSecurityGroup

  ASGForLinux:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub "ASG-Linux-${AWS::StackName}"
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplateLinux
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplateLinux.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 1
      MaxSize: 3
      DesiredCapacity: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LinuxInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  ASGForWindows:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub "ASG-Windows-${AWS::StackName}"
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplateWindows
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplateWindows.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 1
      MaxSize: 3
      DesiredCapacity: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WindowsInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref MyVPC
  LinuxASGName:
    Description: Auto Scaling Group for Linux instances
    Value: !Ref ASGForLinux
  WindowsASGName:
    Description: Auto Scaling Group for Windows instances
    Value: !Ref ASGForWindows
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for SSM managed instances
    Value: !Ref SSMInstancesSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Multi-tier AWS network environment with secure public/private subnets, NAT Gateway,
  and SSM-managed EC2 instances. This template creates a VPC, Internet Gateway, two public subnets,
  two private subnets, a NAT Gateway, route tables, security groups, IAM role with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore,
  and two EC2 instances (one public hosting Apache/PHP and one private backend).

Mappings:
  AWSRegionToAMI:
    us-east-1:
      AMI: ami-0c2b8ca1dad447f8a
    us-west-2:
      AMI: ami-08962a4068733a2b6
    eu-west-1:
      AMI: ami-047bb4163c506cd98

Resources:

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MultiTierVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MultiTierIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PublicInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP ingress from anywhere
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicInstanceSG

  PrivateInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS ingress only from the public instance security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PublicInstanceSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateInstanceSG

  EC2SSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Path: /

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2SSMRole
      Path: /

  PublicInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      ImageId: !FindInMap [AWSRegionToAMI, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref PublicInstanceSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: |
          #!/bin/bash
          yum update -y
          yum install -y httpd php
          systemctl start httpd
          systemctl enable httpd
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicInstance

  PrivateInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      ImageId: !FindInMap [AWSRegionToAMI, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref PrivateInstanceSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateInstance

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Automated image analysis pipeline using S3, Lambda, Step Functions, and Rekognition.
  This template creates an S3 bucket to store images, a Lambda function triggered by S3 PUT events
  that initiates a Step Functions workflow, and two additional Lambda functions:
    - ImageAnalysisFunction: Uses Amazon Rekognition to detect human faces in the image.
    - SmsAlertFunction: Publishes an SMS alert via SNS when a human face is detected.
  An SNS topic with an SMS subscription is used to send alerts.

Parameters:
  SmsPhoneNumber:
    Description: The phone number that will receive SMS alerts (in E.164 format, e.g. +1234567890)
    Type: String
    Default: "+11234567890"

Resources:

  #######################################
  # S3 Bucket and Notification Setup
  #######################################
  ImageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn:
      - PipelineStarterFunction
      - PipelineStarterFunctionInvokePermission
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-bucket"
      NotificationConfiguration:
        LambdaConfigurations:
          - Event: 's3:ObjectCreated:Put'
            Function: !GetAtt PipelineStarterFunction.Arn

  #######################################
  # SNS Topic for SMS Alerts
  #######################################
  SmsAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic

  SmsAlertSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sms
      Endpoint: !Ref SmsPhoneNumber
      TopicArn: !Ref SmsAlertTopic

  #######################################
  # IAM Roles for Lambda Functions and Step Functions
  #######################################
  PipelineStarterFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function

      FunctionName: PipelineStarterFunction

      Role: !GetAtt PipelineStarterFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              sf_client = boto3.client('stepfunctions')
              state_machine_arn = os.environ['STATE_MACHINE_ARN']
              response = sf_client.start_execution(
                  stateMachineArn=state_machine_arn,
                  input=json.dumps(event)
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps(response)
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Sub "arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:ImageAnalysisStateMachine"

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ImageAnalysisFunction
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt ImageAnalysisFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')
              s3 = boto3.client('s3')
              bucket = event.get('Records', [{}])[0].get('s3', {}).get('bucket', {}).get('name')
              key = event.get('Records', [{}])[0].get('s3', {}).get('object', {}).get('key')
              if not bucket or not key:
                  return {'faceDetected': False}
              response = rekognition.detect_faces(
                  Image={
                      'S3Object': {
                          'Bucket': bucket,
                          'Name': key
                      }
                  },
                  Attributes=['ALL']
              )
              faceDetails = response.get('FaceDetails', [])
              result = {'faceDetected': len(faceDetails) > 0, 'faceCount': len(faceDetails)}
              return result

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: SmsAlertFunction
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt SmsAlertFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          def handler(event, context):
              sns = boto3.client('sns')
              topic_arn = os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN']
              message = "Alert: Human face detected in uploaded image."
              sns.publish(TopicArn=topic_arn, Message=message)
              return {'alertSent': True}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SmsAlertTopic

  PipelineStarterFunctionInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    DependsOn: PipelineStarterFunction
    Properties:

      Principal: s3.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AWS::StackName}-image-bucket"

          "Comment": "State machine for image analysis pipeline",
          "StartAt": "AnalyzeImage",
          "States": {
            "AnalyzeImage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:ImageAnalysisFunction",
                "Payload.$": "$"
              },
              "Next": "HasFaceChoice"
            },
            "HasFaceChoice": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.faceDetected",
                  "BooleanEquals": true,
                  "Next": "SendSmsAlert"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "NoAlert"
            },
            "SendSmsAlert": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:SmsAlertFunction",
                "Payload": {
                  "originalInput.$": "$"
                }
              },
              "End": true
            },
            "NoAlert": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Jenkins server deployment across multiple Availability Zones using Auto Scaling.
  This template creates a new VPC, two public subnets in different AZs, an Internet Gateway,
  a route table with default route, Network ACLs, a security group for Jenkins, IAM role for SSM,
  a launch template to install and configure Jenkins, and an Auto Scaling Group to maintain availability.

  AWSRegionAMI:
    us-east-1:
      AMI: ami-0c2b8ca1dad447f8a
    us-east-2:
      AMI: ami-0aeeebd8d2ab47354
    us-west-2:
      AMI: ami-0e34e7b9ca0ace12d

Resources:

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsVPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsPublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsPublicSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsPublicRouteTable

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsPublicSubnetNACL

  InboundHTTP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  InboundHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  InboundJenkins:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:

      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 8080
        To: 8080

  OutboundAll:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: -1
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

  Subnet1NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl

  Subnet2NetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl

  JenkinsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Jenkins servers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsSecurityGroup

  JenkinsInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Path: /

  JenkinsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref JenkinsInstanceRole
      Path: /

  JenkinsLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: JenkinsLaunchTemplate
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !FindInMap
          - AWSRegionAMI
          - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - AMI
        InstanceType: t3.medium
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref JenkinsSecurityGroup
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt JenkinsInstanceProfile.Arn
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash
            yum update -y
            amazon-linux-extras install java-openjdk11 -y
            # Install Jenkins prerequisites
            wget -O /etc/yum.repos.d/jenkins.repo https://pkg.jenkins.io/redhat-stable/jenkins.repo
            rpm --import https://pkg.jenkins.io/redhat-stable/jenkins.io.key
            yum upgrade -y
            yum install jenkins -y
            systemctl enable jenkins
            systemctl start jenkins

  JenkinsAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref JenkinsLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt JenkinsLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '1'
      MaxSize: '3'
      DesiredCapacity: '1'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: JenkinsAutoScalingInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID for the Jenkins deployment
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  AutoScalingGroupName:
    Description: Auto Scaling Group Name
    Value: !Ref JenkinsAutoScalingGroup
  LaunchTemplateId:
    Description: Jenkins Launch Template ID
    Value: !Ref JenkinsLaunchTemplate

Description: >
  CloudFormation template to deploy an encrypted Amazon EFS file system with mount targets in two public subnets,

    Properties:

        - Key: Name

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

        - Key: Name

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select

        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedSecurityGroup
